bottom_line: The council will review the plough rota in the spring — will 3 ploughs be enough if 42 cm falls again?

headline.dek: The most snow in a single day since records began in 1988.
headline.title: Fallowfield's deepest day of snow

scenes.question: How deep was the snow?
scenes.why: The 42 cm total is the number the whole story turns on — worth guessing before the reader sees it, with the scale after as the payoff.

scenes.question: How far past the old record did it go?
scenes.why: Two numbers carry the scale: the new total against the old record.
